schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 015A - Plugin Configuration Entry

questions.label: How should users open a plugin's configuration form?
questions.help: Recommended: primary click toggles the plugin panel, while a secondary action opens the plugin's configuration form. This preserves the original header icon toggle behavior.
options: Primary click toggles panel; secondary action opens plugin configuration
Primary click opens configuration; separate control toggles panel
Primary click toggles panel; configuration is only in Settings > Plugins

questions.label: Where should users change a plugin's left/right placement?
questions.help: Recommended: inside the plugin's own configuration form, stored in user-level config. This matches your correction that plugins configure their own user-facing settings.
options: Inside the plugin's own configuration form
By dragging the icon between header sides
Plugin default only; user cannot change side

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether the secondary action is right-click, long-press, a small gear/menu, or a Settings route opened from the plugin panel.
